message.content:
**Answer:**  
One of the single most celebrated sculptures of the entire nineteenth‑century is **Auguste Rodin’s “Le Penseur” (“The Thinker”)**, finished around 1888–1890. Though Rodin began working on the figure in the mid‑1870s, the bronze casts produced in the 1890s made it instantly recognizable worldwide. Its powerful pose, expressive form, and philosophical title captured the era’s fascination with individualism and modernist aesthetics—making it arguably the most famous sculpture of that period.
